fieldValues.title: 187 allowlisted violations, each pinned to the unit that will clear it
fieldValues.summary: The checker ships holding 187 known violations, and every entry cites a live issue: #562 (baked headings), #563 (the concept tree wiring), #564 (invariants as leaves). The allowlist fails on any violation not listed, on any entry that no longer matches, and on any entry without an issue reference — so it can only shrink.
evidence: 187 entries in scripts/spec-coherence-allowlist.json, each carrying an issue reference
164 orphan leaves (119 invariants -> #564, 45 design-notes -> #563) and 121 baked headings in 22 records (-> #562) make up the bulk
The check fails when an allowlist entry no longer matches a violation (shrink discipline) and when an entry cites no issue; both cases are covered by the guard fixture
fieldValues.body: An allowlist without a shrink rule becomes a permanent exemption list; an allowlist whose entries carry no issue reference becomes a list nobody can act on. Both failure modes are made loud here — a stale entry is an error, not a silent pass — so the count is a live measurement of the rework's remaining distance rather than accumulated debt.
